scope_of_deliverables.quote: The City of Medicine Hat ("the City") is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners. The LMS will streamline end-to-end content delivery, automate assignments and reminders, standardize reporting, and integrate with the City's existing identity, collaboration, and human resources systems.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: E. MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS Refer to the Functional Requirements, Scope of Work, and the Evaluation Criteria
value: User Management & Administration - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) - Admin, Instructor, Manager/Supervisor, Learner; configurable roles & permissions; organizational/departmental hierarchies; team dashboards.
Compliance Tracking - Track compliance training, certifications, manage expiration dates, and support audit trails.
Performance Tracking - Detailed performance tracking for both learners and courses, with integration into advanced analytics.
Reporting, Dashboards & Analytics - Real-time and scheduled reports, exports (CSV/XLSX), custom fields; manager dashboards for team compliance; API-based data access.

External User Management and Access - Ability to securely create, manage, and issue training and courses to users outside the internal city tenant, including temporary staff, volunteers, contractors, vendors, and external agencies.
Customer Support - 24/7 customer support services, with clear SLAs. Performance at 99.9% uptime, fast load times.

User Interface & Experience - Customization, Branding and Visual Identity - Customize the look and feel to match organizational branding/white-labeling, including configurable dashboards and departmental customization.
Mobile Compatibility - Ensure functionality and accessibility on mobile devices, with a mobile-responsive design with offline options preferred.
Social Learning - Features to support social learning, such as discussion forums and peer reviews.

Accessibility - Comply with accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG 2.1 AA, ACA, CHRA) and support assistive technologies such as screen reader, keyboard navigation, captioning support; accessible quiz and video players.
Content Management - Course & Content Management - Create, upload, and manage courses, curricula, and learning paths; version control; prerequisites; due dates and expiry/recertification.
Registration Management - Define registration rules, including course size, waitlists, enrollment notification workflows, attendance tracking. MS Teams integration for virtual sessions.
Assignments & Automation - Auto-enroll by role/department/location; automated reminders; escalation to managers for overdue training.

Content Delivery - Support blended learning (self-paced eLearning, virtual instructor-led, and classroom). Deliver course content efficiently, including support for multimedia formats and use of Content Delivery Network (CDN).
Assessments & Quizzes - Create, deliver and manage assessments, quizzes, and surveys.
Learning Catalog & Search - Browsable catalog, tags, filters, keyword search; configurable enrollment flows and approvals.
Learning Path - Create learning paths either mandated or recommended (optional).

Certifications & Compliance - Issuance and management of certifications, including integration with compliance tracking. Certification paths, renewal/recertification windows, grace periods, automated reassignments; audit-ready records.
Real-time Updates - Real-time content updates and notifications for learners.
Content creation - Course development platform standards & formats: Support SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI (Tin Can), video, PDF, and web content. Optional: AICC, cmi5.
Gamification - Badges, points, leaderboards (configurable).

Integrations - Integration and compatibility: integrate with other systems (e.g. content authoring tools, third-party apps like Microsoft Viva, SharePoint, Email/Outlook, Unit4 Enterprise Resource Planning System/HRIS and Finance System), with robust API support. Bi directional data sync for organizational structure, roles, employment status, and learning completions.
API Support - Robust API support for integration with other city systems, data sources, and Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI). (Note if need middleware). API documentation required.
Interoperability - Support for SCORM, xAPI, AICC, and LTI standards for seamless content integration.
Technical Requirements - Security & Privacy - Ensure data security. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit to protect against unauthorized access.
Single Sign On (SSO) and/or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) - Secure login with single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
Vendor Cybersecurity Compliance - Compliance with industry security best practices (SOC2, ISO, etc.).
PIPA Compliance - Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA.
Incident Response Plan - Vendor has an incident response plan.
Business Continuity Plan - Vendor has a business continuity and disaster recovery (BCP/DR) plan.
Data Retention Policy - Clear data retention policy, including post-contract data management.
Data Storage - Option for cloud storage in Canada or on-premises storage.
Scalability - Ability to scale with the growing needs of the organization, including high availability, load balancing, and elastic scaling.
Deployment - Flexible deployment options (cloud-based, on-premises, hybrid).
Vulnerability Management - Regular pen tests, patch cadence, vulnerability disclosure program.
Sandbox Environment - Continue to provide a sandbox environment throughout the lifecycle of the contract.
Third-Party suppliers or subcontractors - Disclosure of third-party suppliers or subcontractors involved in service delivery.
Security Incident Breaches - Disclosure of any past security incidents or breaches and remediation actions taken.

pricing_structure.quote: Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for GST, which should be itemized separately. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all COVID-19 related costs (including without limitation all cross border isolation/quarantine costs, schedule delay costs and personal protective equipment costs), all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law.

insurance_requirements.quote: 2.2.1. Commercial General Liability Insurance in respect to the Services and operations of the Contractor for bodily injury and/or property damage with policy limits. Not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000.00) per occurrence with a property damage deductible not exceeding Two Thousand Five Hundred ($2,500.00) Dollars. The insurance shall include, to the satisfaction of the City: 2.2.1.1 The City of Medicine Hat as an Additional Insured; 2.2.1.2 Standard non-owned automobile liability; 2.2.1.3 Broad Form Products and Completed Operations Liability; 2.2.1.4 Cross liability; 2.2.1.5 Employer's liability insurance with limits of liability of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000.00) per employee for each accidental injury to, or death of, an employee of the Consultant or of a sub-consultant, engaged in the Services; Or Contingent Employer's liability 2.2.2. Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance in respect to the Services with policy limits of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per claim with a 12-month maintenance period, a deductible of not more than $25,000 and with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000. 2.2.3. Cyber Liability Insurance, where applicable, providing cyber liability insurance, including, without limitation, coverage for cyber-related errors and omissions, media liability, network and information security liability, regulatory fines, penalties with associated forensic investigation expenses, and security breach remediation and notification, for a minimum of $2,000,000 per occurrence for claims for first and third-party costs or damages resulting from any unauthorized access or disclosure, theft, dissemination, and/or use of confidential information or personal information stored or transmitted in any form resulting from any cyber events (including but not limited to network security breaches, privacy events, ransomware attacks) or arising during the performance of the Services. The policy will name the City as an additional named insured, except with errors and omissions. If the policy is written on a claims-made basis, then coverage shall be maintained for a period of two years following the performance of the Services. 2.2.4. Automobile Liability insurance (Owner's Form) in respect of all vehicles used in the performance of the Contract, with limits of no less than Two Million ($2,000,000.00) Dollars inclusive per occurrence for bodily injury, death, and damage to property.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points). Product Demonstration: The evaluation will be conducted in two stages. In Stage 1, all proposals will be evaluated against the rated criteria for a subtotal of 100 points, including a technical component worth 50 points. Proponents must achieve a minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points to meet the technical threshold. The top-ranked proponents that meet the technical threshold, up to a maximum of six, may be invited to participate in Stage 2, at the City's discretion. Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration.
